Another sequel to an old preset, yes, but i really wanted to do new version of this after i discovered the trick i used in 'Slash Spiral' :)

Anyway, not much into it, just the spinning and flying blades and the background fadeout. Hopefully atleast the reactions fit to something aggressive and loud. Oh and i did try to give the blades a slight chrome touch and it does look atleast better than just plain white, wouldn't bet on the realism factor though. But then again i've never cared about realism in avs that much.
